IdempotencyKey.description: Optional key for safe retries of authenticated, non-streaming POST, PUT, PATCH, and DELETE requests, scoped per tenant and verified principal (API-key credential ID or subject). Final 2xx and 4xx responses are retained for 24h. Identical retries replay the original status and body with X-Idempotency-Replayed: true; original responses omit that header. A different method, normalized request target or raw body returns 422 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_MISMATCH; an in-flight duplicate returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_IN_PROGRESS with Retry-After. Secret-returning routes and responses over the configured size cap (default 256 KiB) block duplicate execution with 409 IDEMPOTENCY_REPLAY_UNAVAILABLE. Failed 5xx attempts can be retried. Omitted keys and GET requests retain existing behavior. A keyed mutation without a verified principal or configured replay storage returns 503 IDEMPOTENCY_UNAVAILABLE before dispatch. If recording a final response fails, the reservation blocks retries until its 24h expiry. Retry-After is a polling suggestion, not a guarantee that the reservation will be released after that delay.
